up: Retrieve all exact activity measurements (where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null) and compound structures (canonical SMILES) for compounds tested in the assay identified by ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1614441. For each activity record, I need the compound's ChEMBL ID, its canonical SMILES, and the activity details: standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, pchembl_value, and activity_id. Only include data from the specified assay.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.pchembl_value,
  a.activity_id
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614441'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
